title: Universal closedness is stable under base change
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a universally closed morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism] and let $g:Y'\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the base-change projection $f':X\times_Y Y'\to Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is universally closed.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01W4 (morphisms-lemma-base-change-proper), the assertion that a base change of a universally closed morphism is universally closed
